name: gb_serial

provenance.read_for: this card's data and logic, written here

registers.name: SC
registers.note: CGB mode: bit 1 is the fast clock, unused bits 0x7C; DMG compatibility mode: as the DMG

sources: Gekkio, Game Boy: Complete Technical Reference
statement: SB/SC: with the internal clock, 8 bits shift at 8192 Hz (CGB fast mode 262144 Hz); with no partner the byte received is 0xFF. Bytes sent are logged in serial_out (test ROMs print their results there).
